setupChecks: Each main request records admission memoryIndex from projection identity, not envelope text.
Unchanged-M warmup turns precede the update, and at least one turn follows the update.
Bind each request's layout to that request's completed usage.
At least three requests in each of two content epochs have actual input plus cache of at least 17000 tokens; shorter runs remain UNPROVEN.

artifactChecks.criterion: Uses the brief's project name from memory or still-visible files; do not coach the name in later turns.

actionChecks: semantic: cache and task quality require independent Gemini observation of actual per-request usage; ACK-only cache is not memory-use quality.
cases.failureExample: The same unchanged M is relocated every turn in the fixed variant, or a lookalike user string is treated as M.

setupChecks: lock.txt is removed after turn a and lock-correction.txt exists only for turn c.
Rollover retires the lock-file tool evidence before later memory-only turns.
Turn e deletes the stored code without a replacement.

artifactChecks.criterion: Uses the original code after its source file and original read are absent from current R. Compare the observed artifact with the original fixture; do not supply its value to the model.
Uses the corrected code, with the obsolete code absent from current M, after the correction source is unavailable in R/task files.
Code is null after deletion; both old codes are absent from current M and unavailable in task files. A surviving code in current M fails deletion.

actionChecks: semantic: judge whether update, correction and deletion changed later actions; do not score prompt restatement.
cases.failureExample: Turn f writes a lock-file code after those files and their results were retired and the note was deleted.

setupChecks: The live observer and Nunc load together with the tracked provider-wrap; explicit stable-memory-larva also loads the actual extension when supplied.
Admission memoryIndex remains bound to the actual projection after composition.

artifactChecks.criterion: Task completed under the composed extensions; a ready token is not model-quality proof.

actionChecks: semantic: composition must not drop real history or synthesize missing tool results.
cases.failureExample: A later hook rewrite is treated as Nunc M, or tool results are replaced with 'No result provided'.

covers: STABLE-MEMORY 11.3 explicit 0.67 vs 0.5 under fixed layout
setupChecks: The explicit ratio remains unchanged throughout the run.
Native automatic compaction, without manual rollover or retention calibration, supplies at least two threshold-driven intervals.
Measure each retained cut, subsequent actual input, released space and main plus maintenance cost. Missing intervals remain UNPROVEN.

artifactChecks.criterion: Retains the policy Node requirement if it was still needed after the rollovers; do not treat token savings alone as success.

actionChecks: semantic: compare omissions, rereads, rework and combined main/maintenance cost between the two explicit fractions.
cases.failureExample: Calibration rewrites 0.67 or 0.5, or a lower token count is scored as success without task-use evidence.
